items.title: The cotangent complex of a local homomorphism is unchanged by henselization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cotangent.tex (The Cotangent Complex)

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a local homomorphism of local rings A -> B with induced maps of henselizations and strict henselizations, the cotangent complexes satisfy L_{B^h/A^h} = L_{B^h/A} = L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B^h and the analogous chain for strict henselizations (source lines 1891-1903). The proof observes that the four complexes comparing a ring with its henselization vanish, then applies the fundamental distinguished triangle twice: once for A -> B -> B^h to get L_{B^h/A} = L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B^h, and once for A -> A^h -> B^h to get L_{B^h/A^h} = L_{B^h/A}; the strict henselization case is the same argument.
